_law: FROZEN BENCHMARK COMPARISON LAW. It describes which comparison operations exist, what each may prove, and what forces UNKNOWN. It contains NO card answer, NO pair verdict, NO member list and NO candidate data. Derived comparison results are external audit output and never become canonical projection facts.
_what: AQ4 shared candidate-neutral COMPARISON ALGEBRA. Packet 7, repaired. Benchmark evaluation law only: it creates no production law, ratifies no architecture, mints no production vocabulary, contracts no dimension and authorizes no candidate encoder. Production AQ4 architecture remains UNRATIFIED.

closure_declaration.missing_is_not_absent: A dimension carrying no fact contributes no atom. It is never read as ABSENT and never yields an absence claim; in the equality operation it is reported as MISSING_FACT and forces UNKNOWN.
closure_declaration.statement: A PROVEN verdict is a claim about the PROJECTED fact sets under comparison. It is NOT a claim that either projection is semantically complete.
closure_declaration.vacuity_guard: Two units with no actionable facts do not compare equal. A vacuous proof is false precision and returns UNKNOWN.
closure_declaration.who_polices_completeness: The symmetric false-precision veto, not the algebra. Every PROVEN verdict enumerates the facts it consumed.

DISJUNCTION_RULE._law: REPAIRED. A disjunctive required value set contradicts a forbidding constraint ONLY WHEN EVERY admissible required alternative is eliminated.
DISJUNCTION_RULE._why_recorded: the quarantined implementation proved EMPTY_INTERSECTION on any overlap between the two value sets, which is a false disjointness proof and therefore a false PROVEN_NOT.
DISJUNCTION_RULE.is_a_contradiction: requiring [artifact, creature] against forbidding artifact AND forbidding creature -- every alternative eliminated
DISJUNCTION_RULE.not_a_contradiction: requiring [artifact, creature] against forbidding artifact -- creature remains satisfiable

contradiction_forms._law: The only admissible proofs of EMPTY_INTERSECTION_PROVEN. Corpus absence is inadmissible in every direction.
forms: a same-value REQUIRES against FORBIDS on one dimension (atom semantics)
incompatible REQUIRES values on a dimension that is closed AND single-valued AND must-have
disjoint cardinality ranges on one dimension
disjoint interval ranges on one dimension

derived_question_layer._law: Consumer answers are DERIVED OUTPUT. They are not canonical projection facts, not an answer key, and nothing here adjudicates any card.

distinguishing_witness._law: An additional ROLE for the existing corpus-witness proof kind, ratified in register #33. NOT a third proof kind. One admissible printed-card witness satisfying antecedent A and DEMONSTRABLY violating consequent B proves that A does not entail B. Witness absence proves nothing and a failed search stays UNKNOWN.

decidability_restrictions.CARD: requires a complete assignment for the dimension; the cardinality is a property of the whole value set
decidability_restrictions.EQUALITY_ONLY_DIMENSIONS: a value or spelling mismatch is NOT violation. UNKNOWN unless independent accepted law proves contradiction
decidability_restrictions.FORBIDS: a positively observed forbidden value MAY demonstrate violation, and needs no completeness declaration -- presence is an observation
decidability_restrictions.INTERVAL: requires a complete assignment for the dimension
decidability_restrictions.MALFORMED_PAYLOAD: NEVER proves violation. Malformed input fails closed to UNKNOWN; the projection validator is what rejects it
decidability_restrictions.OPEN_VOCABULARY_OR_INCOMPLETE_ASSIGNMENT: no negative inference of any kind
decidability_restrictions.REQUIRES: non-satisfaction demonstrates violation ONLY where the witness carries an evidence-traced COMPLETE assignment for that dimension. Without completeness the result is UNKNOWN

organizing_law._statement: A UNIVERSAL claim is contract-provable; an EXISTENTIAL claim needs a corpus witness.
organizing_law.consequence: Non-entailment and overlap are existential and need a witness; entailment and disjointness are universal. This is why an inability to prove something can never become PROVEN_NOT.
organizing_law.existential: There is an object satisfying X (and violating Y) -- not provable from contracts, because non-contradiction is not nonempty intersection. Requires a positive witness.
organizing_law.universal: Every object satisfying X also satisfies Y -- provable from the dimension contracts, the atom semantics and the CR hierarchy.

participant_correspondence.B1_unchanged: A complete unit binding and a complete participant correspondence are NOT positive evidence of whole-unit semantic equality. Correspondence may enable an independently proven participant-scoped difference and therefore a B1 negative; it NEVER creates a B1 positive.
participant_correspondence.comparator_lift: A participant-scoped fact may be compared across cards ONLY through an explicitly supplied frozen correspondence. The comparator performs no global lookup, resolves the mapping by BOUND UNIT ADDRESS so a mapping cannot be applied to another pair, and inverts it under operand reversal rather than reusing it.
participant_correspondence.coverage_obligation: Coverage is correspondence-aware. Corresponding mapped scopes participate; an actionable restricted participant that is UNBOUND on either side prevents eligibility equality from being PROVEN; an extra actionable participant is never silently ignored. The conservative result is UNKNOWN — an extra participant never becomes PROVEN_NOT unless existing law independently proves non-equivalence.
participant_correspondence.no_mapping: UNKNOWN, with the existing NO_PARTICIPANT_CORRESPONDENCE reason. Ordinal equality is NOT a fallback, constraint similarity is NOT a fallback, and correspondence is never inferred.
participant_correspondence.one_mapping_per_pair: ONE frozen mapping is reused across every applicable question for that pair. Generating alternate mappings per question, or trying mappings until a desired verdict appears, is forbidden alignment-shopping.
participant_correspondence.proves_nothing: The correspondence itself establishes no semantic relation. It only makes participant-scoped facts comparable; the verdict still comes from the existing atom and dimension law.
refused: participant-level expansion of the pair population

two_distinct_problems._law: Solving the first does NOT solve the second. Local ordinal equality across cards carries no semantic correspondence, and `participant 0 here equals participant 0 there` is never an inference rule.
two_distinct_problems.cross_card_semantic: Once two units are bound, which participant on one corresponds to which on the other. THIS LIVES IN THE BENCHMARK BINDING LAYER, never in the projection.
two_distinct_problems.same_occurrence_cross_export: Key and candidates may independently export participants for the SAME occurrence. Canonical anchors plus anchor-derived numbering align them. THIS LIVES IN THE PROJECTION.

projection_dependency._law: The algebra consumes ONLY documents that validate under this exact schema at this exact version. THE PROJECTION VALIDATOR IS AUTHORITATIVE for payload shape; this file never re-implements it as a competing validator. Defensive handling may still fail closed, and a malformed payload NEVER becomes semantic evidence. Participant ordinals are anchor-derived at that version, which is what makes a supplied cross-card correspondence resolvable at all.

proof_kinds.CORPUS_WITNESS: Established from one named printed card, in one of two ratified ROLES (below). Carries corpus_ref, witness identity, admissible evidence, the governing dimension contract, and any completeness declaration relied upon.
proof_kinds.CR_CONTRACT: Established from ratified contract law -- a dimension contract, the atom semantics, a CR-closed vocabulary, or the ratified subtype-to-type hierarchy. The record names the dimension and a REAL rule anchor.
proof_kinds._law: Exactly two, both PROVENANCE on the derived relation. A proof kind is never a verdict and nothing branches on it except the audit trail. No third proof kind is created.

proof_record._law: Derived audit material, never canonical semantic truth. A proof record may never be written back into a projection document.

components._law: ONLY genuine semantic proof components enter the three-valued composition. A component carries a result, and where the result is PROVEN or PROVEN_NOT it carries a proof kind and a REAL contract anchor.

proof_record.cr_anchor_law: A contract proof must cite a real applicable rule or contract anchor. EXPLANATORY PROSE IS NEVER AN ANCHOR.
proof_record.ordering: components and preconditions sorted canonically; symmetric operations canonically order their operands so the record is byte-identical under reversal.

preconditions._law: REPAIRED, register #37. A structural check that was evaluated and did NOT block is recorded HERE and nowhere else. It carries no comparison result, no proof kind and no anchor, and it never enters the composition. A non-blocking check is not a proof.

proof_record.trace_obligation: A PROVEN or PROVEN_NOT record carries at least one evidence reference from a consuming component, and a corpus-witness record additionally pins its corpus_ref. An UNKNOWN record carries a registered reason class. Self-checked on every record.

result_domain._law: Exactly three. No fourth public comparison verdict. UNKNOWN is first-class and never means false, absent, incompatible, disjoint, or searched-and-not-found.
